name: Steiff - Margaret Strong Cinnamon Mohair Teddy Bear With Leather Paws
description: Steiff - Margaret Strong Cinnamon Mohair Teddy Bear with leather paws 18cm # 0156/18. This is the smallest size which originally came in a boxed set of four which was limited to 2000 sets. Some of the sets were broken up and sold individually. He is made of mohair, had a squeaker, is fully jointed and about 7" tall. He was signed and dated but the signature and date is faded some and blurry. The is done wear on the paw pads as pictured. A great teddy to add to your collection. Smoke free.
